entries.title: A reviewer circles the work it is reviewing
entries.body: During a review on a Careful task, the reviewing crewmate now circles the crewmate whose work it checks, instead of two glowing dots spinning around the reviewed one. It circles until the review ends, then leaves like any finished crewmate. When that circle is crowded, it stays in its place with a line to the crewmate it reviews. Its summary names the task it is reviewing.
entries.noPicture: The main change is a crewmate's motion around another on the stage, which a still picture cannot show.
